svg.text: Lunar habitat, extinction conditions: recorded oxygen and pressure of the 273 counted tests
Nominal point of the scenario: 30 % oxygen, 70.3 kPa. Position relative to the region: outside.
Computed by the team's code from NASA PSI tables (code written with an AI assistant). All 273 tests are droplet tests of one investigation (PSI-69, FLEX).
The region describes where tests exist; it judges nothing. Not a NASA figure.
